title: Twin Accusation
next_chapter_hook: The Fate Chronicler sneered: "Do you see it? Even your shadow rebukes you."

text.content: The intertwined golden light of three bonds violently shook in the river of fate, and Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center—the Tianji Record Fragment was warning him frantically. Yet in the next moment, a cold yet familiar voice came from the depths of fate, directly piercing through all forbidden seals. "Brother... how much longer will you make me wait?" That voice was not a question but an accusation. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and his fingers trembled involuntarily. It was her. It was Chen Ling—the very Chen Ling he had been searching for across five entire scrolls. At this moment, her voice overflowed with unprecedented fury.

At the end of the river of fate, a phantom slowly materialized. Chen Ling's appearance was exactly as Chen Ji remembered—the same eyes, the same contours, yet with an entirely different temperament. Golden chains wound around her form, the seals the Holy Sect had bound her with for years. But now, those chains were being broken free, one link at a time. "I waited for you for so long, brother." Her voice was soft, yet each word cut like a blade, "While you were scheming across the world, while the Holy Sect used me as a vessel, every time you used the Tianji Record—did you ever think of me?"

dialogue.content: By what right do you decide my fate for me?

text.content: Chen Ji opened his mouth, only to find his throat blocked by something. He wanted to say "I did it to protect you," wanted to say "Everything I did was to grant you freedom," but facing his sister's eyes burning with fury, all the grand justifications felt hollow. He suddenly realized he had never once asked what Chen Ling wanted. Never. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly within the Tianji Record, as if waiting for something.

Chen Ling's phantom stepped forward violently, golden chains behind her emitting piercing cracking sounds. "Do you think I'm your chess piece? Think I'm part of the Tianji Record? Think my purpose is to become your source of power?" Her voice grew increasingly sharp, "I'll tell you, Chen Ji—I am not!" In the torrent of fate, a consciousness not belonging to Chen Ji was awakening—a spark of independent will.

dialogue.content: I want to be myself! Not your shadow, not your power source, not some Heavenly Fate key!

text.content: Chen Ji's face turned deathly pale. He never imagined that the obedient, gentle sister in his memories harbored such intense fury and longing within. What terrified him even more—if Chen Ling's independent will truly awakened, the original chess game would completely spiral out of control. His grand vision spanning seven entire scrolls might be ruined by a single "accident." For the first time, he felt genuine fear.

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Ling's furious accusation, Chen Ji must respond. His choice will determine the direction of this sibling conflict, and whether Chen Ling's independent will can truly awaken.

choices.description: Use the power of the Tianji Record to suppress Chen Ling's newly awakened independent consciousness. Preserve the chess game, but possibly lose your sister forever.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily stabilize the chess game, Chen Ling's consciousness suppressed
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may never forgive you

text.content: A ruthless glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He raised his hand, and the Tianji Record pattern on his brow center blazed brilliantly as golden light, substantial as essence, swept toward Chen Ling. "I'm sorry, A-Ling." His voice was soft yet carried undeniable resolve, "Some sacrifices are necessary."

choices.description: Retract all seals, acknowledge Chen Ling's right to exist as an independent being. Respect her choice, even if it means losing her.
choices.visible_cost: The chess game may encounter variables
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ling's independent will fully awakens, possibly becoming a true ally rather than a chess piece
choices.risk_hint: You may lose control of the overall situation

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long time. The sound of the river of fate roared in his ears, and he suddenly remembered the little girl from many years ago, always trailing behind him, shouting "Brother." Slowly, he withdrew his hand, and the light at his brow center dimmed little by little. "You're right, A-Ling." His voice was somewhat hoarse, "I never asked what you wanted. From now on... you decide for yourself."

choices.description: Attempt to establish a deeper connection with Chen Ling's consciousness—not suppression, not letting go, but true soul resonance.
choices.visible_reward: May unlock the "Shared Fate" enhanced form, Chen Ling becomes a true twin partner
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the gaze of the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward, reaching out his hand. This time, he did not invoke the power of the Tianji Record, but touched that phantom with the most primal emotions of an elder brother. "A-Ling, if this is what you want—" His voice trembled slightly, "We can walk together. I don't want to control you, I want... to stand by your side." The golden chains stopped abruptly before his palm.

Chen Ling was stunned. She had expected more lies and evasions, never imagining Chen Ji would say such words. In those familiar eyes, there was no scheming, no calculation—only a sincerity she had nearly forgotten. "Brother..." Her voice softened, and the cracking sounds of the chains gradually ceased. Yet just then, a cold laugh echoed from the depths of fate.

That voice was ice-cold and transcendent, belonging to no one, yet seeming to stand above all. "Interesting." The voice carried a certain playful amusement, "The bond between twins—truly the most fascinating game. Chen Ji, did you think you could have it both ways? Did you think letting go was respect? Did you think fusion could solve everything?" The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's brow center jumped frantically—it was the warning of being observed by some supreme being.

Chen Ji's expression instantly darkened. He recognized this voice—the terrifying truth he wouldn't realize until Volume Eight. "Heavenly Eye." He spoke word by word, his voice suppressing torrential hatred and fear, "So you have always been watching." Upon hearing this name, Chen Ling's pupils contracted sharply. She had seen this name in Holy Sect texts—the terrifying existence that treated all prophets as chess pieces.

dialogue.content: Watching? I do far more than watch. Every step you take is a step I permitted you to take. Including this moment—you think you're making a choice, but you're merely performing according to the script I wrote.

text.content: Chen Ji's hand tightened secretly within his sleeve. The Heavenly Eye's mockery made his heart shiver, but years of scheming had cultivated in him the habit of never revealing weakness. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, forming a dangerous curve. "Is that so?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Does the script mention that I already know you're watching, and that I've prepared a grand gift for you?" The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew faintly warm.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's mockery, Chen Ji decided to reveal his trump card. He would show this self-proclaimed chess master with real action—Chen Ji has never been anyone's chess piece.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to show the Heavenly Eye a future it absolutely should not know—directly challenge its authority.
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Eye falters for the first time, revealing the true origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May expose the greatest secret of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and urgently activated the Tianji Record. A golden light unprecedented in scope burst from his brow center, piercing through the barrier of fate. Within that light, a blurred image emerged—the location of the Heavenly Eye's true body, and an existence that made even it tremble. "Do you see it?" Chen Ji's voice was icy cold, "You think you're the chess player, but you don't realize you're also someone else's chess piece."

choices.memory_label: 向天道之眼展示禁忌预见

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye is watching, let it witness the might of twin collaboration—Chen Ling's independent will may be the key to breaking the game.
choices.visible_reward: Establish temporary resonance with Chen Ling, triggering a special skill
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ling may distrust you due to the earlier confrontation

text.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Chen Ling, a determined light flashing in his eyes. "A-Ling, I know you hate me." His voice was low, "But now, there's a more important enemy." Chen Ling's phantom was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded. "Fine." She said only this one word, yet it filled Chen Ji's heart with an indescribable warmth—this was the first time in many years they would fight side by side.

choices.memory_label: 联手陈灵对抗天道之眼

text.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent. That transcendent consciousness, after observing the image Chen Ji displayed, revealed genuine emotion for the first time—shock, and a trace of deeply hidden fear. "How could you possibly know this..." Its voice lost its usual commanding composure for the first time, "The Tianji Record is merely a fragment, how could you peer into that realm..."

Chen Ji gave no answer. He knew some answers could not be revealed too early. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled in the first page, as if reminding him the time wasn't right. But one thing he could be certain of now—the Heavenly Eye was not invincible. It had weaknesses, it had fears. And this realization was his first step toward breaking the chess game. Chen Ling stood beside him, the golden chains completely shattered, replaced by a faint layer of silver light.

"The Fate Chronicler sneered: 'Do you see it? Even your shadow rebukes you.'" The Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, this time carrying a strange pleasure, "Chen Ji, you think you're rebelling against fate? Wrong—your shadow, your sister, everyone around you is part of fate. Your anger, your struggle, your choices—all are within my script." As the words fell, the river of fate began to churn violently.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's provocation, Chen Ji must make his final response. At this moment, he will decide how to demonstrate his dignity as a chess player before this unknowable existence.

choices.description: Openly acknowledge the Heavenly Eye's power, secretly gather strength, wait for the opportune moment. Fits Chen Ji's consistent style of playing the fool before striking.
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing room, buy time for subsequent scheming
choices.risk_hint: May cause the enemy to underestimate you even more

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile was gentle yet sent a chill down one's spine. "You're right." He slightly lowered his head, his tone appropriately respectful, "I am but a mortal, how would I dare contend with Heavenly Will? Today's lesson, Chen Ji has learned." With that, he quietly drew Chen Ling into the shadows of the river of fate. The Heavenly Eye seemed satisfied with his attitude, the pressure of its gaze slightly diminishing—and this was precisely what Chen Ji wanted.

choices.description: Give the Heavenly Eye no face, declare war on the spot. Let it know Chen Ji is no piece to be moved at will.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose your ambitions, may provoke harsher suppression
choices.visible_reward: Establish a true brother's image before Chen Ling, earning her respect
choices.risk_hint: May trigger the decisive battle with the Heavenly Eye prematurely

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a sharp light flashing in his eyes. "Script?" His voice turned ice-cold, carrying a near-mad confidence, "Then let me see if this screenwriter can write his own ending." He spoke word by word, "Chen Ji's fate, I myself will write." As the words fell, a thunderclap exploded in the river of fate—the first time the Heavenly Eye was truly enraged.

Chen Ling gazed at her brother in bewilderment. The brother in her memory who always wore a gentle smile, hiding all pain in his heart—at this moment, his eyes burned with fire enough to contest Heaven. She suddenly understood how deeply Chen Ji had hidden his "waste" persona all these years. And her former resentment felt so insignificant now. "Brother..." Her voice was as light as a sigh.

Chen Ji turned to look at his sister, his gaze holding less scheming and more of the warmth an elder brother should have. "A-Ling, I'm sorry." His voice was soft, "All these years, I made you suffer." Chen Ling's phantom trembled slightly, the golden chains completely vanished, replaced by a faint ring of silver light connecting her faintly to Chen Ji. This was the bond of twins—not a seal, but a tether. The river of fate gradually calmed, yet everyone knew this was merely the calm before the storm.

Just as the three bonds intertwined, a strange voice suddenly rang out from the depths of fate—it was Chen Ling, Chen Ji's sister who had been missing for years. Why would her voice appear here? Now, the answer was revealed. She was not merely a sister needing to be saved, but an existence with independent will. And Chen Ji finally, for the first time, treated her as an equal rather than a chess piece. The Fate Chronicler sneered from the shadows: "Do you see it? Even your shadow rebukes you."—but this time, a hint of wariness that Chen Ji could perceive was added to that sneer.

Chen Ji sensed that wariness, and the curve of his lips deepened. The Heavenly Eye was wary of him—this meant he was on the right path. The chess game ahead would be a true heaven-defying transformation of fate. And beside him, no longer was there a sister needing protection, but a comrade who could stand shoulder to shoulder. The gears of fate turned quietly, and the final confrontation of Volume Seven was about to begin. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul in the first page of the Tianji Record let out a soft sigh: "Phase One, complete."
